cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(cute-icons NONE)

include(FeatureSummary)

# Crule: the upstream Lingmo icon theme, kept for users who picked it
install(DIRECTORY Crule DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/share/icons)
install(DIRECTORY Crule-dark DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/share/icons)

# Lingmo / Lingmo-dark: Lingmo's own app icons, generated by lingmo-theme/generate.py
# (SVG + PNG renders), inheriting WhiteSur for everything they don't draw
find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
set(LINGMO_THEME_OUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/lingmo-theme)
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${LINGMO_THEME_OUT}/stamp
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E rm -rf ${LINGMO_THEME_OUT}
    COMMAND Python3::Interpreter ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lingmo-theme/generate.py
            --out ${LINGMO_THEME_OUT} --optimize
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E touch ${LINGMO_THEME_OUT}/stamp
    DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lingmo-theme/generate.py
    COMMENT "Generating the Lingmo icon theme"
    VERBATIM)
add_custom_target(lingmo-icon-theme ALL DEPENDS ${LINGMO_THEME_OUT}/stamp)

# Lingmo, Lingmo-dark (whose app dirs link to Lingmo's) and the hicolor fallbacks
install(DIRECTORY ${LINGMO_THEME_OUT}/icons/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/share/icons)
# Neutral plates for third-party icons
install(DIRECTORY ${LINGMO_THEME_OUT}/lingmo-icons/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/share/lingmo-icons)

# Third-party app icons on plates: a pacman hook writes the Lingmo-generated theme
# into /var/lib/lingmo-icons (owned by no package); the package owns only the link
install(PROGRAMS lingmo-theme/lingmo-icons-update DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/bin)
install(FILES lingmo-theme/lingmo-icons.hook DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/share/libalpm/hooks)
install(CODE "
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY \"\$ENV{DESTDIR}${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/share/icons\")
    file(REMOVE \"\$ENV{DESTDIR}${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/share/icons/Lingmo-generated\")
    file(CREATE_LINK /var/lib/lingmo-icons/Lingmo-generated
         \"\$ENV{DESTDIR}${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/share/icons/Lingmo-generated\" SYMBOLIC)
")
